name: Grilled Pork Tacos with Avocado & Fresh Peach-Lime Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Combine spices in a small bowl.
Heat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and season with spice mixture on both sides.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Cooking in batches if necessary, add pork and cook, flipping occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Halve and pit peaches. Working in batches if necessary, add peach halves to the grill pan, cut-side down, and cook until the flesh is soft and charred, about 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board, medium dice, and add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Juice limes into the bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine the salsa.
Meanwhile, thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips.
Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with pork slices, peach salsa, and avocado. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
